Himmat pehla insani gun hai—kyunki ye baaki sabki guarantee karta hai.
Himmat impossible ko doable banati.
Courage decide karta: fear future decide nahi karega.
Saahas dar ki anupasthiti nahi, balki us par jeet hai.
Bohot defeats mil sakte, par defeated nahi hona.
Bahadur hona: afraid hoke bhi move.
Bahadur bano, risk lo.
Saat baar giro, aathvi baar utho.
Humein brothers jaise saath rehna seekhna chahiye—warna fools ki tarah saath perish.
Courage i resistance to fear, mastery of fear—na absence of fear.
Toofan ka saamna karo.
Fear ke bina courage rare hai.
Shaant logon ka dimaag sabse shor machata hai.
Khamoshi sabse heavy sach sambhal sakti.
Fear utni hi gehri jitni mind allow kare.
Himmat utthan hai.
Grit hai, zindagi ko matters samajh ke jeena.
Chuppi sabse zor ki cheekh hai.
Bahaduri andar se aati hai.
